• FC Goa vs Bengaluru FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 26 || 06-Nov-2026 || English ||
Late, late drama in Fatorda! Watch the big moments as Bengaluru FC beat FC Goa 2-1 with a stoppage-time winner to stay unbeaten in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Borja Martínez and Francisco Feuillassier traded goals inside the first 17 minutes. Bengaluru created the better chances after that, and Soham Varshneya finally won it in the 93rd minute from Ashique Kuruniyan’s pass.
